body.x: Otiton Medical Co., Ltd. (CEO Jayden Kim) participated in CES 2026 Unveiled, held on January 4 (local time) in Las Vegas, the United States.

Otiton Medical is a Korean company that develops digital healthcare medical devices enabling individuals to observe and detect ear diseases at home and, based on the results, connect to appropriate medical services. The company explains that it introduced these technologies and products to address the limitations of ear disease management methods that rely heavily on hospital visits, particularly in preventing progression to severe complications that commonly affect infants and young children.

In particular, Otiton Medical works with otolaryngology specialists at domestic university hospitals to collect inner-ear imaging data and continuously improve the performance of its AI-based diagnostic algorithms, which underpin ear disease diagnosis. Alongside this effort, the company evaluates clinical applicability and product usability, and it continues to develop solutions capable of addressing conditions such as pediatric otitis media and otitis externa that require repeated observation.

At the Otiton Medical booth at CES 2026 Unveiled, the pet smart thermometer emerged as a key product. The company designed it to allow users to manage both ear health and body temperature for companion animals without visiting a hospital. Using an endoscope capable of capturing images inside the ear, the device records the condition of the eardrum and external auditory canal and visually presents the collected data through a mobile app.

AI-based analysis algorithms process images and videos transmitted to the app and generate intuitive diagnostic results. By detecting inflammation, abnormal patterns, and changes over time, the system helps owners make decisions, such as whether a hospital visit is necessary. This near “all-in-one solution” user experience aligns with the smart thermometer that received a CES 2025 Innovation Award.

Otiton Medical applied and expanded its proprietary technology, which enables at-home diagnosis and follow-up management of human ear diseases, to introduce the pet smart thermometer. With this product also selected for an Innovation Award, Otiton Medical achieved the distinction of winning two consecutive years of awards.

body.cap: Jayden Kim, CEO of Otiton Medical, demonstrates the company’s smart treatment device to overseas media. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Otiton Medical also showcased a next-generation smart treatment device that uses dual near-infrared LED wavelengths to help alleviate ear inflammation. This device records ear conditions before and after treatment and provides guidance on improvement by having AI analyze changes in condition.

An Otiton Medical representative said, “We are pleased to unveil our new pet smart thermometer at Unveiled, a venue that brings together global media and industry stakeholders, and to introduce the concept and future direction of a home-based ear disease management solution that encompasses both humans and companion animals.” The representative added that the company focused on collecting feedback on usability, clinical applicability, and market-entry requirements during this year’s event.

The representative continued, “Through exchanges made here, we plan to gather feedback from a wide range of stakeholders, including healthcare professionals, medical device distributors, healthcare companies, and investors at home and abroad, to further refine product use scenarios and directions for improvement.” The representative emphasized, “With priority on Japan, the United States, Australia, and Brazil, we will collect key information on country-specific regulations and distribution structures, and pursue phased expansion starting with local PoC projects and partnerships.”

body.x: Meanwhile, the company will also participate in the leading CES 2026 exhibition, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-dedicated exhibition zone. The CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion, led by the Seoul Business Agency (SBA), brings together 19 startup support organizations in Seoul, including district offices, related institutions, and universities, to support 70 startups. The participating companies span advanced technology fields such as AI, mobility, and healthcare, and selected outstanding firms receive opportunities to participate in the official CES media event, CES Unveiled.

‘CES Unveiled’ is a key official event held before the CES opening, bringing together Innovation Award winners and companies showcasing cutting-edge products. The event brings together global media, company executives, government officials, and significant technology industry stakeholders in one place.
